rows.en: (EX-Gear training went off without a hitch!)
You were flying really well out there.

Hearing that from you gives me confidence,
Yuuto.
I can't afford to slack off either.

...Hey, \p.
Do you have time after this?
Yeah, I'm free.

Then how about one more flight?
I want to check our formation.
Got it.
Alright, let's get ready!

(...I'll work hard to close the gap with Yuuto,
even a little!)
(EX-Gear training went off without a hitch!)

Hearing that from you gives me confidence,
Kagura-kun.

(...I'll work hard to close the gap with
Kagura-kun, even a little!)

(What a tiring week~
I'm gonna take it easy this weekend~)

You look awfully happy.
Did something good happen?

Yuuto, don't you get excited just because
it's Friday?
I know the feeling.
So what are your plans for the weekend, Yuuto?

First I'll clean my room, then go grocery shopping
with Mom, then visit Dad's grave...
I've got plenty to do.
...That's a pretty full weekend...
Is it? I think everyone's is about the same.
(...And I'll probably just sleep through mine...)
Well, I'm heading home.

(...Maybe I'll do something this weekend
for a change of pace...)

Kagura-kun, don't you get excited just
because it's Friday?

So what are your plans for the weekend,
Kagura-kun?
(...And I'll probably just laze around...)

(...Gym class is next, huh.
Gym on a cold day is such a drag.)

\p.
Why the gloomy face?

It's just gonna be another long run.
That's what's getting me down.
rows.notes: 'Marason' is the long-distance run in gym class (cf. c16818).

rows.en:
What's wrong with that?
It's simple. I like it.

Maybe so, but...
the distances Gary-sensei makes us run
are insane...

If you just keep your legs moving and
don't think, won't it start to get fun?
If only it were that simple...

Come on, Sensei's waiting for us.
Let's go, let's go!
(...Well, I'll give it my best, I guess.)

(...Gym class is next, huh...
Gym on a cold day is such a drag...)

It's just gonna be another long run.
That's what's getting me down.

Maybe so, but...
the distances Gary-sensei makes us run
are awful.

(...Wandering around town with no plan
isn't so bad.)

Fancy meeting you here,
\p.
Yuuto! What are you doing here?

I'm thinking of buying a new tripod
for my photography.

Photography?
You have a hobby like that!?
Is that so surprising?

My dad got me into it.
I've been at it for five years now.
Show me your photos sometime.

Sure, I'll bring some to school next time.
Well, I'm getting back to my shopping.
(I wonder what kind of photos he takes.)
I-is that so surprising?
Show me your photos sometime!

(Swimming's next, huh...
I'd better warm up properly.)

\p.
Let's warm up together.

There sure are a lot of pretty girls
at our school, huh?
rows.notes: 'Uchi no joshi': the girls of our school/class; shared by both versions.

rows.en:
It's rare for you to bring that up, Yuuto.
I figured you weren't all that interested.
I'm a guy too, you know.
...I hope this'll be a fun class.

...Yeah.
Now, I'll push your back.
Sit down and stretch your legs out~
Owowowowow!!
(I-I'll do my best at swimming!)

Huh?
S-sure, I guess...

So you notice that kind of thing too, Kagura-kun.
I figured you weren't all that interested.
...I-I see...

Now, I'll push your back.
Sit down and stretch your legs out~

uncertain: c17020: Kagura mentions visiting his father's grave (his father is dead in this script); not in the glossary profile, translated as written.
